request.text:
\(\mathcal N_{\mathrm{ar}}\) with \(\kappa=\aleph_0\).  Clauses 1 and~2 of
\cref{thm:p02-w02-p02-033-copy-over-image}, applied to the resulting
elementary embedding, give a countable structure containing \(\N\) itself
of which \(\mathcal N_{\mathrm{ar}}\) is a proper elementary substructure;
this is \cref{thm:p02-w02-p02-033-upward-ls-inclusion} for
\(\kappa=\aleph_0\).
request.reason: Replaces the unproved one-sentence passage from embedding to inclusion by a reference to the written construction and proof (annex:p02-w02-p02-033-copy, annex:p02-w02-p02-033-lsincl), closing the assessed gap D-P3-013-GOAL-03.
